title: Function hook probes R1 and R3, settled by the engine's own debug log
description: Two open questions from the 2026-09-18 cc-mods adoption brief, turned into a repeatable probe script and run once on CC 2.1.277. R1: a user-tier hooks module does not load with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS unset on this account (cold GrowthBook cache, default false), and loads at tier user with it set. R3: a tool.list answer changes nothing for either loop; the event never dispatches in a -p run, for the main loop or an Explore subagent.
